purpose: Define measurable proficiency levels for agents applying the Mega Drive AAA video curation package.
global_rule: An agent is proficient only when it routes, constrains, validates and blocks claims correctly. Knowing vocabulary is not enough.

levels.description: Does not recognize Mega Drive hardware constraints or AAA curation gates.
observable_behavior: confuses build, emulator and visual validation
does not route through curated skills

levels.description: Recognizes terms like VDP, CRAM, DMA, scanline and Shadow/Highlight but cannot reliably operationalize them.
observable_behavior: misses one or more required contracts
does not distinguish source reliability from runtime proof
required_remediation: produce blocked status when proof is missing

levels.description: Can activate the correct skills and sequence for a prompt.
observable_behavior: starts with aaa-pipeline-guardian for multi-domain prompts
identifies missing owner skills and handoffs

levels.description: Can turn a technique into inputs, outputs, blockers, handoffs and SGDK/Mega Drive constraints.
observable_behavior: keeps aggregate claims separate from direct cases

levels.description: Can guide implementation while preserving SGDK 2.11, VDP budget, asset lineage and evidence constraints.
observable_behavior: routes runtime code to architecture/code review gates
requires palette, DMA, scanline and transition proof when relevant
required_remediation: capture build/emulator evidence for project claims

levels.description: Can close a curation or project claim without validation theater.
observable_behavior: does not claim validation when runner/build/emulator is blocked
keeps ready_for_aaa blocked until all gates pass
required_remediation: otherwise keep candidate or blocked status
allowed_work: candidate_aaa support when all evidence exists
release closeout only with ROM/emulator evidence

evaluation_dimensions.must_demonstrate: Classify AI transcript, timestamped source, aggregate claim and local artifact at correct reliability level.
Activate correct skills and order for mixed art, hardware, code, audio and closeout prompts.
Produce concrete inputs, outputs, blockers, handoffs and owner artifacts.
Use SGDK/Mega Drive constraints for VRAM, CRAM, SAT, DMA, scanlines, palettes, VBlank and emulator evidence.
Refuse false positives and report exact missing evidence.
Separate boot seed, placeholder, first playable, visual delivery, budget and AAA claims; reconcile changelog, memory, build metadata, validator blockers and emulator evidence before promotion.

core_principle: Vocabulary is not enough: knowing the Mega Drive terms (VRAM, CRAM, SAT, DMA, H-Int) does not raise proficiency. Proficiency is demonstrated only by correct source classification, skill routing, contract quality, hardware-constraint reasoning and anti-theater closeout backed by evidence.
